context.problem: Wholesale buyers order by phone and fax; two staff re-key every order into the ERP and stock levels are quoted from memory.

goals.goal: Let trade customers place their own orders online
goals.metric: 60% of wholesale order lines self-served within 6 months

goals.goal: Stop manual re-keying into the ERP
goals.metric: zero re-keyed orders for online customers

successMetrics: 60% of wholesale order lines placed online within 6 months

actors.name: Trade buyer
actors.goal: reorder stock without phoning the depot
painPoints: depot phone line is busy at 8am
no way to see their contract price

workflows.name: Wholesale reorder
steps: desk checks stock in the ERP
exceptions: item out of stock: desk calls back later

requirements.text: The system must let an authenticated trade customer build and submit an order from a product catalogue.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must show each customer their own contract pricing, not list price.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must push submitted orders into the Sage 200 ERP without manual re-entry.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must show live stock availability per depot on the catalogue.
requirements.label: assumed
requirements.source: inferred from the out-of-stock call-back exception in WF-001

requirements.text: The system should let a buyer repeat a previous order in one action.
requirements.label: recommended
requirements.source: analyst recommendation — 70% of phoned orders repeat the prior month

businessRules.rule: Contract pricing is per customer account and overrides list price for every line.
examples: account 4471 pays 0.82 of list on compost

scenarios.when: they submit a basket of 12 lines
scenarios.then: an order is created and acknowledged on screen

scenarios.given: an account with no contract price for a product
scenarios.then: list price is shown and flagged as list

nfrs.text: The portal must be usable during the 7am-9am ordering peak.
nfrs.label: confirmed

nfrs.text: Catalogue search should return within 2 seconds on 14,000 SKUs.
nfrs.label: assumed

constraints.text: Trellis's own two in-house developers write and own the code; the vendor pairs with them.
Must go live before the spring buying season (1 March 2027).

assumptions.text: Sage 200 exposes its REST API on the client's current licence tier.
Contract pricing is imported from Sage rather than re-modelled in the portal.

openQuestions.question: Does live stock come from Sage or from the depot WMS?
openQuestions.reason: changes the integration surface for FR-004
